Commentary.Commentary: So, the batters have done the job for the hosts now, the onus will be on the bowlers to deliver. Zimbabwe have a good batting line-up but they will have to bat out of their skins to scale this mammoth total. Can Zimbabwe fight against the odds and shock all the cricketing world or will normalcy prevail and Bangladesh seal the series? Join us in a while for the chase.

The hero of the first innings for the hosts, Tamim Iqbal is caught down for a quick chat. Tamim says that he has been batting well but he couldn't get the bigger scores. Thanks the team management and his teammates for the support. Adds that he was hitting the ball really well in the nets and he knew that it was just a matter of time. Feels that he got lucky early on as he got a few balls on his pads and that helped him. Reveals that they have set the target of having at least one of the top 5 should bat till the 40th over. Feels that Zimbabwe have quality batters in the side and they will have to bowl in good areas to win this game.

It was yet another sorry show from the Zimbabwean bowlers. They failed to get wickets in the crucial middle overs and looked out of ideas and were taken aback by Tamim's class. They did manage to pull things back towards the end and restored some parity by restricting Bangladesh under 330 when 340 looked on course. 7 bowlers were used in total but it was a difficult day for all of them. Donald Tiripano and Carl Mumba picked up 2 wickets each, while Wesley Madhevere and Charlton Tshuma had one apiece but they were all expensive.

After opting to bat, it was the Tamim Iqbal show. Bangladesh have missed the heroics of their talisman for sometime but he came back and looked like his old self. Tamim found his vigor, dominance and class and his superb innings of 158 ended his century drought and helped the hosts by leaps and bounds. His knock along with the supporting roles from Mushfiqur Rahim and Mahmudullah took the game to Bangladesh and helped the Bangla Tigers reach 322.

A good comeback from Zimbabwe in the final 5 overs and they have managed to restrict Bangladesh under 325 when 350 looked inevitable at one stage. Without a shadow of a doubt though it will be Bangladesh who will be the happier of the two sides heading into the break.

HUNDRED FOR TAMIM IQBAL! The time all of Bangladesh has been waiting for has finally arrived. Tamim has broken the shell of bad form and the barren spell of more than a year without a hundred. He had a very difficult 2019 but 2020 looks like the year Tamim has found his groove. He will be a mightily relieved man and with him getting back in form Bangladesh look a lot better side. This has been a very good knock from him. Even though he was involved in 2 run outs he held his end and made it count. A subdued celebration from him. A sign of how big the burden was on him before this knock. The crowd is celebrating in joy and Tamim hugs Mahmudullah and raises his bat. Coming to the ball, it is a floated delivery on off, Tamim pushes it through covers and gets a couple to get to the triple figure score. He will now look to convert this into a daddy hundred. Maybe even aim for 200.

FOUR! Tamim is on fire! Short delivery on leg, Iqbal pulls it through square leg for a boundary. This is good batting from Tamim Iqbal.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery on middle, Iqbal flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a good length on off, Najmul keeps it out.
FOUR! Great shot! Full delivery on off, Hossain Shanto drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary. 50 up in quick time for Bangladesh.
Back of a length ball on middle, Iqbal hops and works it towards square leg for a run.
Quick run to get off the mark. Shortish ball around off, pushed towards mid on for a single by Hossain Shanto.
Good length ball outside off, Iqbal runs it down to third man for a run.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! A length ball on the pads, Iqbal flicks it to short fine leg where the fielder dives over the ball and allows it to roll to the fence.
Donald Tiripano is into the attack.
Beauty to end the over! A length ball coming into the batter from outside off, Hossain Shanto pokes at it but misses. End of a successful over for Bangladesh.

Quick single but this wasn't too far away from the stumps at the non-striker's end. Length ball just around off, Iqbal forces it down the ground. It goes to the left of the bowler who tries to move to his left and collect the ball but fails to do so. It goes towards mid on for a run.
Shortish and around off, Iqbal keeps it out.
Najmul Hossain Shanto is the new batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is an unfortunate way to get out but Das has to depart. A good length ball around off, Tamim strokes it back to the bowler who tries to field but the ball hits his leg and ricochets to the stumps at the non-striker's end. The bowler then appeals and the umpire refers it upstairs. Let's see if Das is out of his crease. Oh, well, he is short. He was out of his crease and tried to get into the crease with his arms stretched but could not do so.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Was Das backing up little too much? Yes, he was. He is short.
FOUR! Nicely clipped! Mumba sprays on the pads for Iqbal. All Iqbal needed was a tickle of his bat. He got that and with fine leg up in the ring, the ball was always going to the fence.
Shortish and around off, blocked off the back foot by Iqbal.
FOUR! Driven nicely! 13 from the over now. A fuller ball outside off for the right-hander this time. Das reaches out and caresses it through the covers for a boundary. Expensive over from Tshuma.
Landed around off on a length, Das pushes it to mid off off his back foot.
Two boundaries and then a single. Sensible from Iqbal. A length ball around off, Iqbal pushes it towards the off side and calls for a quick single.
FOUR! This one is drilled through the covers. This is excellent batting. Tshuma overpitches this wide outside off, Iqbal leans into the shot and drills it through the covers.
FOUR! Top shot! Slightly fuller and around off, Iqbal comes forward and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Good length ball around off, Iqbal comes forward and keeps it out.
Good length ball on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle, Das looks to work it on the leg side but it takes the leading edge and goes towards point.
Length ball around off, Das keeps it out.
Back of a length ball on middle, Iqbal tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish and on middle, Das works it behind square leg for a run.
Landed around off on a length, Das hangs away on his back foot and keeps it out.
Loose shot! Fuller length ball just outside off, Tamim is drawn for the drive but the ball shapes away and is beaten.
Good length ball outside off this time, Iqbal lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! This one is from the middle of the bat. Another fuller one on the pads, Iqbal this time middles his flick and sends it whistling to the fence at deep square leg.
FOUR! Very full ball on the pads, Iqbal looks to flick but it looked like it came off his pads and raced to the fence but the umpire signals it as a boundary which means he got some bat to it.
In the channel around off on a good length, Iqbal pokes at it to get beaten as the ball shapes a hint away.
Bouncer and it is just outside off, Das sways away from the line to get through the over.
Fuller and around off, Das pushes it towards mid on.
Good length delivery on leg, Iqbal looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
On a good length on off, Iqbal defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! That is demolished! Short delivery on middle, Iqbal pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Iqbal drives it to covers.
Liton Das has hurt his finger. The physio has come out in the middle.
Good length delivery on middle, Liton blocks it off the back foot. Just a run from Tshuma's first over.
On a good length on off, Das keeps it out.
Full delivery on middle, Iqbal flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Tamim defends it off the front foot.
On a good length and outside off, Iqbal offers no shot to this one.
Tshuma starts with a length ball around off, Tamim keeps it out.
Charlton Tshuma to bowl from the other end.
A single now as Mumba bowls this length ball just outside off, Das strokes it wide of the cover fielder for an easy run. 5 from the first over.
FOUR! First one of the innings and it is a brilliant flick by Liton. Very full ball on the pads, he whips it off his pads and the ball races away to the fence at deep mid-wicket.
Angled into the bat to the right-hander, Das looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Tamim and Bangladesh are underway. A good length ball shaping away a hint. Iqbal guides it to third man for a run.
Good length ball around off, Tamim once again comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Mumba starts with a length ball around off, Iqbal comes forward and works it towards mid on.
We are all set to begin. The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle. Liton Das and Tamim Iqbal will open the batting for Bangladesh. Carl Mumba will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe.

Sean Williams, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that it is awesome to be back with the team. Adds that they didn't get the kind of start they wanted but they will look to do a lot better here. Tells he would've have loved to bat first but the toss is not in their control. Feels that a couple of hundreds from their players will be really well.

Mashrafe Mortaza, the Bangladeshi skipper, says that the pitch is looking similar like the last game and there won't be too much dew and hence the decision of batting first. Tells that there are a couple of changes in the team. Shafiul Islam replaces Mohammad Saifuddin and Al-Amin Hossain replaces Mustafizur Rahman.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo is down for the pitch report. Tells that there is a lot of grass on the wicket which was not the case in the last game. Adds that it is quite overcast right now and there is plenty of rain around the country but hopes that the rain will stay away from the ground. Tells that boundaries are short square of the wicket. Adds that the grass is a little longer and greener but there won't be a lot of movement. Feels that the captains will look to bat first. Tells that there won't be a lot of dew either. Finishes by saying that conditions are perfect for batting.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Regis Chakabva, Sean Williams (C) (In for Chamu Chibhabha), Brendan Taylor, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Richmond Mutumbami (WK), Tinotenda Mutombodzi, Donald Tiripano, Carl Mumba, Charlton Tshuma (ODI DEBUT) (In for Chris Mpofu).

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Liton Das, Tamim Iqbal, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Mohammad Mithun, Mehidy Hasan, Mashrafe Mortaza (C), Taijul Islam, Shafiul Islam (In for Mohammad Saifuddin), Al-Amin Hossain (In for Mustafizur Rahman).
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and elect to bat.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd ODI between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe in Sylhet. After thumping the visitors by 169 runs in the opening game, Bangladesh would look to seal the deal with one match still to go. It was a powerful batting performance which was led by Liton Das' top knock. After posting a massive target, the Bangladeshi bowlers bundled out the visitors for just 150. They will once again look to repeat their performance to seal the deal here only. Let's see how this encounter pans out. Team and toss update shortly.
